available.label: Available
available.consequence: The described public experience is ready to inspect.
available.evidence: Repository-validated public content and deterministic interface tests.

demonstrative-preview.label: Demonstrative preview
demonstrative-preview.consequence: You can review the complete interaction, but no native or remote state changes.
demonstrative-preview.evidence: A controlled local preview and receipts that confirm nothing was changed.

under-validation.label: Under validation
under-validation.consequence: Do not assume compatibility or a performance result until evidence is complete.
under-validation.evidence: The validation boundary and missing proof are stated with each claim.

planned.label: Planned
planned.consequence: The capability is part of the roadmap and is not available for use.
planned.evidence: The item is clearly marked as future work and no delivery date is promised.

unsupported.label: Unsupported
unsupported.consequence: The configuration is outside the supported product boundary.
unsupported.evidence: The compatibility boundary explains why no action is offered.

unavailable.label: Unavailable
unavailable.consequence: The action is blocked and no bypass is provided.
unavailable.evidence: The page explains what is still required before the action can be safely enabled.

records.title: More gaming performance without giving up control
records.summary: Liiiraa Boost analyzes your PC, recommends only what fits it, and shows the before and after.
records.body: You decide what to apply and keep a clear way to undo every change. The app is still in development, so results will appear only after your own PC has been measured.
limitations: Real-hardware inspection and Windows changes are not available in this public version yet.
No gain, issue count, launch date, or universal compatibility is claimed.

evidence.scope: Deterministic desktop review, evidence, and recovery journeys
evidence.unprovenBoundary: Native optimization behavior and per-machine performance remain unproven.

sections.title: Before anything changes
sections.body: Check Windows, hardware, drivers, and the game to avoid generic tweaks.

sections.title: See the result
sections.body: Compare before and after using data from your own PC — no invented percentages.

sections.title: Go back whenever you need
sections.body: Every change keeps a history and an easy-to-find restoration path.

records.title: Results you can verify
records.summary: Every improvement must come from a measurement on your own PC, not a generic estimate.
records.body: Liiiraa Boost shows the before and after, explains where each number came from, and makes it clear when something could not be measured yet. A hypothesis never appears as a promise.
limitations: The current preview shows how the product separates information; it does not measure a real PC yet.
A simulated value remains an example, never a result.

evidence.scope: Repository content admission and deterministic scenario evidence
evidence.unprovenBoundary: Representative device and game measurements are not yet available.

sections.title: What counts as a result
sections.body: A comparison made on the same machine with visible sources and conditions.

sections.title: What never becomes a promise
sections.body: Simulations, estimates, and interface tests are never presented as real gains.

records.title: Is your PC compatible?
records.summary: Check Windows and system type now. Full hardware analysis will arrive with the app.
records.body: The check considers your processor, graphics card, drivers, and game before recommending any adjustment. If information is missing or a configuration is unsupported, Liiiraa Boost explains it instead of forcing a result.
limitations: Windows 10 lifecycle and edition support must be checked against current Microsoft support.
ARM64, unsupported Windows builds, and unknown hardware receive no compatibility claim.

evidence.unprovenBoundary: Specific hardware and game support require observed inventory and validated profiles.

supportMatrix.consequence: The initial check works the same way on both Windows versions.
Recommendations appear only after the app identifies the PC components.
You can explore the flow, but this public version does not change Windows yet.
The app does not recommend adjustments when safe support cannot be guaranteed.

records.title: Plans are not on sale yet
records.summary: You can explore the product now and decide later, without fictional prices or hidden conditions.
records.body: When subscriptions open, price, renewal, included devices, cancellation, and refunds will appear together before purchase. Until then, this page shows only what you can already explore.
limitations: No paid plan, charge, renewal, or refund can be created from this preview.
Prices and commercial terms will be published only when purchase is genuinely available.

evidence.unprovenBoundary: Final commercial prices and payment-provider behavior are not yet approved.

plans.name: Liiiraa Boost preview
plans.taxes: No taxes are charged because no transaction is available
plans.cancellation: There is no subscription or purchase to cancel
plans.refunds: No payment is accepted, so no refund event can exist
plans.deviceRules: No device entitlement or binding is created
plans.expirationEffects: Preview access does not create or expire a paid entitlement
plans.checkoutBoundary: Purchase is not available yet; any confirmation in this preview is demonstrative and creates no charge

capabilities.name: Explore the product and check compatibility

records.title: Search public, validated content
records.summary: Results expose content type, locale, version, availability, and validation state.
records.body: Search is submitted explicitly and stored in the URL. It indexes only admitted public records and never account, admin, scenario, preview-authority, or internal records.
limitations: Current search covers repository-authored records shipped with this public application.
Private data and obsolete actionable content are never included.

evidence.scope: Public-only route, locale, version, availability, and validation filters
evidence.unprovenBoundary: No external or private content source is connected.

searchCopy.label: Search product, evidence, compatibility, plans, and support
searchCopy.emptyBody: Revise the query or remove a filter. Search does not expose private content or incompatible versions without notice.

records.title: Support begins with a safe path
records.summary: Start with public documentation and share only the minimum data needed.
records.body: Public support helps you recover safely without collecting diagnostics on this page. If submissions are enabled later, every field must be visible, removable, and explicitly approved by you.
limitations: No support case, attachment, diagnostic bundle, or account record is submitted by this page.
Do not include passwords, authentication secrets, payment data, or unrelated personal information.

evidence.unprovenBoundary: Authenticated cases and consent-scoped diagnostic submission are not available yet.

collectionPoint.requiredFields: No data is collected by this public page
collectionPoint.retention: No submission means no support record is retained
collectionPoint.revocation: Future consent can be withdrawn before submission and through the privacy center
